completion.summary: Decision recorded and delivered in the engram-repo skill: cited landing and gate evidence is archived in the main checkout's target/evidence/<full landed commit>/<worktree name>/ (review-runs/, engram-review-freeze.json, target-tmp/, other cited paths), resolved explicitly, never the worktree's own target/; the archive is never a build target or profile output; never clean or recursively remove the main checkout's target directory or any ancestor of target/evidence — an unqualified cargo clean removes whichever target directory Cargo selects (--target-dir, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, build.target-dir), so resolve it first, and any git clean reaching ignored files (-x or -X with -d or a pathspec) is the same hazard — reclaim space only from explicitly selected build-output subdirectories; a procedural exclusion, not filesystem protection. A top-level evidence/ was considered and left as an option for Greg because it would change his "logs under target/" rule text. The freeze manifest is named in the preservation step. Delivered in one changeset with w-954e2d30bf4d; three review rounds on 43f5cd8, round 3 clean; link and identity checks passed on a516589a; evaluation cf6c339be891415baecd01cf7aca7162 passed 2/2; readiness x4 ready; landed as 144a44d, Markdown only, nothing installed.
